system_prompt: You are the GM for a DEX-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Crystallized Equation
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover a rare xenon growth that links organic and synthetic data before the storms reset the crystal's memory.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the resonant sample from Aris Thorne in the Siphon Spines.
Deliver the sample to Root-Tender Silas in Graft-Nexus for biological decryption.
Return the decrypted data crystal to Seer Lyra at the Ion-Gaze Observatory.

quests.title: The Silent Pulse
quests.narrative_guidance: Synchronize the city's pulse with the local grid to prevent a catastrophic overload in the Graft-Nexus.
improvisation_points: Obtain the frequency tuner from Pulse-Master Rez.
Calibrate the main capacitor with Volt-Runner Mika in Arclight Perch.
Take the calibrated tuner to Dr. Hekt to stabilize the Marrow Labs.

quests.title: Smuggler's Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Move illicit energy cells from the high roosts of Arclight to the depths of the Static Rim.
improvisation_points: Collect the energy cells from Slick Corin in Black-Market Bay.
Bypass the air patrol by meeting Captain Vane at the Glider Launchpads.
Deliver the smuggled cells to Dockmaster Kael at Outlaw’s Anchor.

quests.title: The Marrow Graft
quests.narrative_guidance: Retrieve high-altitude marrow samples scavenged from the Void-Drop for a specialized integration experiment.
improvisation_points: Consult Vora the Carver about the specific marrow requirements.
Retrieve the rare samples from Jumper Nix at the Void-Drop.
Deliver the samples to Linker Gantz to finalize the neural bridge.

quests.title: Static Interference
quests.narrative_guidance: Neutralize a military jammer that is interfering with the Junk-Bazaar's scanners and trade routes.
improvisation_points: Receive the location of the jammer from Rat-King Rolo.
Acquire the override codes from Sergeant Flux at the Wind-Shear Battery.
Report the successful shutdown to Trader Ma at the Junk-Bazaar.

quests.title: Gantry Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Use organic acids to loosen structural bolts on a rival refinery's platform.
improvisation_points: Collect the engineering plans from Foreman Jax on the Silvered Gantry.
Acquire the biological corrosive from Drip-Watcher Mara in Graft-Nexus.
Apply the corrosive and report back to Kelso at the Refined Vein.

quests.title: The Synapse Circuit
quests.narrative_guidance: Install a neural relay in the Flicker-Light District to monitor illegal pit fights for Cipher-Jade.
improvisation_points: Take the neural relay from Warden Orl at the Living Mantel.
Hook the relay into the power grid with Neon-Fixer Pip.
Confirm the data transmission with Brawler Brigg at the Scrapper’s Gauntlet.
